Non Binary Bike Club Wednesday Ride

Brooklyn, NY · Fort Greene · Social

LGBTQ+No-drop

Non Binary Bike Club Wednesday Ride is a social group ride in Brooklyn, NY. It rolls every Wednesday at 7:00 pm from Fort Greene Park, just inside the Willoughby Ave / Washington Park entrance. Pace: moderate, no-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: moderate, no-drop. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Non Binary Bike Club Wednesday Ride group ride

A year-round Brooklyn bike club for non-binary riders and allies. The Wednesday ride is moderate and no-drop, and usually ends somewhere for food or drinks. Each week's destination and route go up on the club site. Bring lights, a lock, a helmet and water.
